text_block_list.text:
While continuing her training for the 
Yayoi Sho under the chilly sky, Silence 
Suzuka was asked by Special Week one day 
to be her training partner.

Silence Suzuka readily agreed to train 
together. Watching her give it her 
absolute all, Suzuka realized that other 
Umamusume run with "dreams" of their own.

For some reason, that stuck strongly in 
her mind, leaving Silence Suzuka feeling 
bewildered.
